reason: Accepted assembler-input exception. ugen's output for the C source is the ROM's block layout, but as1's cross-block scheduler hoists the default arm's obj reload (lw t0,184(sp)) into the switch head because the one-instruction default block is dominated by the head and t0 is dead at every jump-table target. The ROM keeps the reload in the default block, which as1 does only when a block-boundary record sits between case 5's `b` and the default label. A zero-size `.align 2` record there reproduces the ROM in all 426 words and leaves the other 39 functions unchanged. No record IDO 5.3 ugen can emit for C at -O2.
